places.name: Jumba la Mtwapa Ruins
places.address: Off Mombasa–Malindi Road, Mtwapa, Kilifi County
places.description: The remains of a 15th-century Swahili settlement with a mosque, houses and tombs, preserved beside the creek as a national monument.
places.alt: Weathered coral-stone ruins of the Jumba la Mtwapa settlement

places.name: Mtwapa Creek
places.description: A tidal inlet lined with mangroves where dhows and fishing boats pass. Come at sunset for the best light over the water.
places.alt: Boats on the calm water of Mtwapa Creek at dusk

places.name: Bamburi Nature Trail
places.description: A former quarry turned wildlife sanctuary with giraffes, hippos, tortoises and walking trails shaded by planted forest.
places.alt: Shaded walking path through a green nature park

places.name: Fort Jesus
places.description: A 16th-century Portuguese fort and UNESCO World Heritage Site with a museum covering centuries of coastal history.
places.alt: Thick stone walls of Fort Jesus in Mombasa

places.name: Nyali Beach
places.description: A long stretch of white sand and shallow water, popular for morning walks, swimming at high tide and fresh coconut.
places.alt: Palm trees along the white sand of Nyali Beach

places.name: Mombasa Old Town
places.description: Narrow lanes, carved wooden doors and old Swahili houses. A guided walk is the easiest way to see the mosques and markets.
places.alt: A narrow street with carved wooden doors in Mombasa Old Town

places.name: Mombasa Marine National Park
places.description: A protected coral reef reached by glass-bottom boat, with snorkelling over colourful fish and sea grass beds.
places.alt: Clear shallow water over a coral reef

places.name: Kenyatta Beach Market
places.description: A lively beachside spot for fresh seafood, local snacks and handmade crafts, busiest on weekends.
places.alt: Stalls and shoppers at a busy beachside market
